diagnosis: The whole authored seal detaches at once and moves vertically, so it reads as a rigid lid instead of a tear front following the top seam.
The source flap is anchored from its top-leading corner, although the authored cut line is at the flap bottom near source y=97/512.
The synthetic opening is full-width from the first readable movement. It does not expose progressively along the gesture path.
Opacity decay plus view clipping retains only 4.4% of the thresholded flap area at commit, creating the user-visible sliver.
The automatic evidence labels partial follow at 1.78 s, but the first substantial Pack change is at 1.983 s.

seamCandidateStripe.interpretation: The stripe can be seen only in an enlarged crop. It occupies 0.13% of the frame and disappears at commit.

arrivalRim.interpretation: The effect produces a broad transparent wash, not a brighter separating object rim.

rotationRim.interpretation: The shader uses one fixed virtual normal response. It does not author one traveling mesh-local pass for each circle.

finalSheenVersusHold.interpretation: A broad low-frequency change exists, but the normal-scale frame lacks a clear crossing edge and reads as ordinary material variation.

rootCauses: Rev 3 tests gated only changed pixels and one maximum pixel. They did not gate changed area, average contrast, p95 contrast, or the normal-scale recording.
Arrival uses a diagonal transparent wash instead of a dedicated object rim.
Rotation uses a static virtual-light response instead of two traveling mesh-local passes.
The final sheen is too narrow and too attenuated by transparent alpha to read as a single crossing event.
No separate commit release pulse exists.

workingPackComparison.boundary: Use the prior physical path as implementation evidence only. Do not restore its holder, branded art, entity, colors, or obsolete transition.
